description: This file defines the DivOverlay class, a base model for map overlays such as popups and tooltips in the Leaflet library. It includes methods for managing overlay positioning, content, visibility, and interaction with the map.

classes.name: DivOverlay
classes.description: A base class for map overlays like popups and tooltips, extending the Layer class with additional positioning and content management functionalities.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the overlay with options and source layer.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the overlay to the map, setting up layout and opacity.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the overlay from the map, including fade-out animation.

methods.name: getLatLng
methods.description: Returns the geographical position of the overlay.

methods.name: setLatLng
methods.description: Sets the geographical position of the overlay and updates its placement.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the current content of the overlay.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets new content for the overlay and updates its display.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element container of the overlay.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the overlay's content, layout, and position.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for map interactions like zoom and view reset.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the overlay is currently open on the map.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the overlay to the front of other overlays.

methods.name: bringToBack
methods.description: Sends the overlay to the back behind other overlays.

methods.name: _prepareOpen
methods.description: Prepares the overlay for opening, determining position and source layer.

methods.name: _updateContent
methods.description: Updates the overlay's inner content based on current data.

methods.name: _updatePosition
methods.description: Calculates and applies the overlay's position on the map.

methods.name: _getAnchor
methods.description: Returns the anchor point for positioning the overlay.
